answer: Stake-age ladder: an identity's reward weight is its locked POA times min(age,30) epochs divided by 30, with a 200 POA minimum lock. Faking 1,000 identities means 200,000 POA frozen for a month before full weight, so each extra fake costs the same again. Like a trellis, weight grows only as slowly as time allows. Auditors sample 6% of wallets each epoch; any that share funding sources lose 30% of the lock. Honest users in tundra-slow periods wait longer, and an opal-sized newcomer stake still earns.
